governance.reason: Conventional Pareto is an additional benchmark outside the primary confirmatory screen. Its rule is inherited unchanged from the earlier AMSS analysis and is applied without posterior refits, selector training, or candidate-action changes.

definitions.predictionOnly: Select the valid candidate with the highest frozen rolling-OOS score. The score uses three time-ordered holdout folds and is monotone decreasing in average WAPE over the observed, non-clipped range.
definitions.conventionalPareto: Form a nondominated set over rolling-OOS prediction error, DECOMP.RSSD between analytic MAP spend and contribution shares, and same-window experiment MAPE when an experiment exists. Select the Pareto candidate with the lowest equal-weight average objective rank; use prediction, decomposition, then candidate ID as deterministic tie-breaks.
definitions.noExperimentRule: For the no-experiment evidence group, calibration is structurally unavailable and the Pareto selector uses prediction and decomposition only.
definitions.evaluation: Selected candidate actions and economic losses are looked up unchanged from the accepted sealed SVI external audit.

regretSetVersusPredictionOnly.estimand: RegretSet-MMM risk minus comparator risk; negative favors RegretSet-MMM

regretSetVersusConventionalPareto.estimand: RegretSet-MMM risk minus comparator risk; negative favors RegretSet-MMM
